department: Department of Chemical Engineering (Molinaroli College of Engineering and Computing)

deadline.value: Fall preferred deadline is March 31; spring October 31; summer February 28.

app_fee.value: The department subsidises the application fee, reducing it to $35, below the Graduate School's $50.
app_fee.quote: subsidies the application fee, reducing it to $35

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; it is optional.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students get a stipend of $35,000 per year with tuition and health insurance; the page does not say all admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: Full-time Ph.D. student stipends currently are $35,000 per year with tuition and health insurance

entry_route.value: A total of 60 credit hours beyond the bachelor's degree is required, so entry from a bachelor's is allowed.
entry_route.quote: A total of 60 credit-hours beyond the bachelor’s degree are required for the Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering

notes: Base stipend rises to $36,000 for Fall 2027.
